daily.title: Le Pen hails 'victory' as French far right secures record 14 seats in Senate
daily.summary: France's far-right National Rally (RN) party and its allies emerged from polls with a record 14 seats in the right-wing dominated Senate on Sunday, effectively quadrupling its number in the 348-seat chamber just months before a presidential election.

daily.title: Pope wraps up 'hugely successful' France visit with Metz speech

daily.title: Thailand floods: At least 8 die, thousands move to shelters
daily.summary: Rain eased in Thailand ’s capital on Sunday, but flooding persisted in several low-lying areas, with thousands forced to move into temporary shelters. At least eight people were reported killed in the past 10 days nationwide.

daily.title: Serbia's populist President Vucic resigns to run for PM
daily.summary: Serbia’s populist President Aleksandar Vucic resigned Sunday to pursue a bid to become prime minister in an upcoming early parliamentary election that will test his firm rule in the Balkan country, which was rattled by nearly two years of protests.

daily.title: REPLAY: France's Macron speaks on European Union as pope visits Metz
daily.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron said that Europe must rediscover the “courage of its founders” and not give in to the “resurgence of nationalism" as he delivered an address alongside Pope Leo XIV in Metz on the last day of the pontiff's visit to France.

daily.title: Trump granting asylum to Afrikaners is 'race-based policy', South African FM claims
daily.summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24 on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, South African Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola said Washington's plan to take in up to 17,500 more White South Africans was "a race-based policy", dismissing the "so-called genocide" of Afrikaners as "fake news".

daily.title: SpaceX to attempt putting Starship rocket into Earth orbit for first time
daily.summary: Space X on Monday will attempt to launch its Starship rocket from Texas into Earth's orbit in a 10-hour flight which would deploy 26 Starlink satellites and would represent a milestone in the development of the massive launch vehicle. But the success of the launch is uncertain, as many previous tests have failed.

Trump raised the possibility of renewed air strikes on Iran but also said he anticipated further negotiations.
